name: Boardwright
description: Chat with your own Claude Code inside KiCad. Takes a board from idea to fab files in eight gated stages.
description_full:
Adds a Boardwright button (a green speech-bubble icon, at the right end of the PCB Editor's top toolbar). It opens a chat window that talks to the Claude Code you have installed on your own computer, started in the folder of the open KiCad project with the boardwright plugin loaded: streamed answers, one line per tool call, Allow/Deny for every permission request, a Stop button.

Boardwright guides a board through eight stages (spec, parts, power budget, schematic, layout, EMC, BOM, release files) and stops at ERC/DRC gates. It never orders, uploads or publishes anything.

Requirements: KiCad 10 with 'Enable KiCad API server' ticked (Preferences > Plugins), Claude Code installed and signed in with your own Claude account (a paid Claude plan or API billing is needed; messages count against it). On first run the window checks this and walks you through it. Sign-in is Claude Code's own browser login; this add-on never asks for, reads or stores a password, key or token.

The chat opens docked to the right side of the PCB Editor and follows it; the Dock button in the chat lets it float as a normal window instead. Docking works on Windows and on Linux with X11 (xdotool); elsewhere the chat is a normal window. Works on Windows and Linux (tested on Windows 11 and Ubuntu 24.04). The window and all messages are in English.
